select task_code, task_name, system_code, pre_requisite_prod, the_batch_prod, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, default_cost_minutes, batch_processing, is_path, pos_x, pos_y, is_flag, remark, created_time, updated_time from monitor_task where (#{monthEndView} = true and batch_processing = 'M') or (#{monthEndView} = false and batch_processing in ('D', 'NM')) order by system_code asc, task_code asc
